title: The spaces, together.
subtitle: 3D / SPATIAL STUDY
body: A cutaway model explores the connection between living, dining, kitchen and study. Pale stone and oak hold the rooms together. An illustrative spatial study, not a measured floorplan.

title: Shape before atmosphere.
subtitle: 3D / LIVING ROOM MODEL
body: A simple shaded model makes the seating, level change and garden glazing easy to read. Faceted furniture and clear model edges keep the focus on proportion and space.
